sources.title: Stadt Wien — Baumkataster
sources.coverage: Complete available Vienna public-tree source inventory. This does not include every physical tree, private trees or all forest trees.
sources.completeness: All WFS rows fetched by strictly increasing OBJECTID keyset; final empty tail and before/after counts verified. The source does not offer a transaction snapshot, so concurrent updates with unchanged count cannot be excluded.
sources.processing: No geographic filtering. Source records retained, including geometry problems reported separately; Geneva observer identities omitted. No proximity deduplication.

sources.title: SITG — Inventaire cantonal des arbres isolés
sources.identity: ID_ARBRE is documented stable but duplicate or missing IDs require release-scoped object-qualified identity. OBJECTID is not permanent.
sources.coverage: Complete available canton-wide inventory of isolated trees outside forests. Historical positions may be inaccurate by about 25 m; recent surveys about 1 m.
sources.completeness: All canton-wide source object IDs fetched in validated batches of 300 with six concurrent requests; initial count and final membership verified. Not a transactionally consistent upstream snapshot.
sources.processing: No geographic filtering. Source records retained, including geometry problems reported separately; Geneva observer identities omitted. No proximity deduplication.

sources.title: Município do Porto — Identificação e caracterização do arvoredo
sources.coverage: Complete published public-domain municipal tree inventory. The age field is an interval, not a planting year; private trees are not covered.
sources.completeness: The complete published GeoJSON resource was downloaded without geographic filtering. No independent upstream total is published.
sources.processing: No geographic filtering. Source records retained, including geometry problems reported separately; Geneva observer identities omitted. No proximity deduplication.

sources.title: Gemeente Amsterdam — Bomen stamgegevens
sources.attribution: Gemeente Amsterdam — Directie Verkeer en Openbare Ruimte
sources.identity: id; release-scoped because permanent cross-release stability is not established
sources.coverage: Complete available municipal tree master records. Includes recorded management locations, not all physical trees. No street-address field is published in this collection.
sources.completeness: All ordered REST GeoJSON pages followed through the final next link; strictly increasing unique IDs and before/after totals checked. Not a transactional source snapshot.
sources.sourceLicense: openbaar, tenzij anders aangegeven / behoudens uitzonderingen
sources.processing: No geographic filtering or proximity deduplication. Complete source rows retained.

sources.title: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg — Straßenbaumkataster
sources.attribution: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg, Behörde für Umwelt, Klima, Energie und Agrarwirtschaft
sources.identity: baumid; release-scoped because permanent cross-release stability is not established
sources.coverage: Complete available public street-tree inventory. Park, forest and private trees are not comprehensively covered. Published source records may lag planting or removal.
sources.completeness: All current WFS street-tree rows downloaded in sorted pages, unique IDs and before/after count reconciled. The current service exposes one layer; obsolete HPA layer names in historical download links are not separate current layers. Not a transactionally consistent upstream snapshot.
sources.processing: No geographic filtering. Singleton MultiPoint geometries converted to Point without changing coordinates. Every source row retained.

sources.title: Stadt Zürich — Baumkataster
sources.attribution: Stadt Zürich — Grün Stadt Zürich / Geomatik + Vermessung
sources.identity: objectid; release-scoped because permanent cross-release stability is not established
sources.coverage: Complete available municipal tree-point inventory, including street trees, fruit trees, selected public green areas and some private trees. Includes records outside the municipal boundary. Park coverage is being expanded gradually.
sources.completeness: Complete tree-point WFS layer downloaded without area filter; before/after WFS hits totals reconciled. Crown polygons and CAD marker circles are representations of the same trees and are not additional records. Not a transactional upstream snapshot.
sources.processing: No geographic filtering or proximity deduplication. Complete source rows retained.

sources.title: Trees in Camden
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. London Borough of Camden.
sources.coverage: All published Camden council tree records; groups retain number_of_trees.

sources.title: London Public Realm Trees
sources.identity: uniqueid (GLA mapping ID; not borough asset ID)
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Greater London Authority and contributing public bodies.
sources.coverage: November 2025 compilation, excluding LB Camden contributor rows replaced by the separate current Camden inventory.
sources.processing: Exact maintainer=LB Camden exclusion; no proximity or species deduplication. Missing coordinates retained.
